Category.title: Category
Category.description: A user-defined category or subcategory (when parentId is non-empty) for organizing saved websites.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

name.description: Display name of the category or subcategory.

icon.description: Lucide icon identifier for the category.

parentId.description: Empty string for root categories, or parent category ID for subcategories.

order.description: Numeric sort order of the category.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the category was last updated.

Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A saved website entry assigned to a category and optional subcategory.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

url.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS URL of the saved website.

description.description: Notes or summary about why this website was saved.

categoryId.description: ID of the root category this website belongs to.

subcategoryId.description: ID of the subcategory, or empty string if assigned only to the root category.

isFavorite.description: Whether the website is pinned to favorites.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user visual customization preferences including primary theme accent color and glass intensity.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

primaryColor.description: Selected theme accent key or hex color.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

QuickShortcut.title: QuickShortcut
QuickShortcut.description: A user-selected quick access website shortcut displayed at the top of the workspace with a customizable icon.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner.

title.description: Display name of the quick access website.

url.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS URL of the quick access website.

iconType.description: How the shortcut icon is rendered: website favicon, vector icon, or custom image URL.

customIcon.description: Empty string for favicon, Lucide icon identifier for lucide, or HTTPS image URL for custom.

order.description: Numeric sort order of the shortcut.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the shortcut was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shortcut was last updated.

SharedCategory.title: SharedCategory
SharedCategory.description: A public, read-only snapshot of a curated category collection (subcategories and bookmarks) shared via a unique link.

ownerId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner who published the share.

categoryName.description: Display name of the shared category.

categoryIcon.description: Lucide icon identifier for the shared category.

isPublic.description: Whether the shared collection is publicly accessible via its share link.

subcategories.description: Bounded list of subcategories inside the shared category (max 100).

bookmarks.description: Bounded list of curated bookmarks inside the shared category (max 500).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the share link was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the shared snapshot was last refreshed.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Stores root categories and subcategories owned by individual users.

/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Stores saved website bookmarks linked to user categories.

/userSettings/{userId}.description: Stores theme color and glassmorphic UI preferences per user.

/quickShortcuts/{shortcutId}.description: Stores top bar quick access website shortcuts with customizable icons.

/sharedCategories/{shareId}.description: Stores public, read-only snapshots of curated category collections accessible by direct shareId.
